_comment: Tuned from recon on 2026-10-03: the login form sits on the landing page as #account / #password with an invisible reCAPTCHA. allowPost takes exact paths only — never a save endpoint.
_allowPost: All seen in recon on the app host after opening the database. db-update-progress.do: the app polling whether ACCURATE's own schema upgrade of the opened database has finished (the name says update, the call reads a percentage). init.do: the app's client bootstrap that loads the menu and session for the browser. dashboard.do: loads the home screen's figures. company/news-page.do: the news feed on the home screen. Nothing in the books changes.
_stubPost: Refused like any write, but answered locally with an empty success instead of an aborted request, because the app retries each failure every few seconds and raises a modal each time, which stops the crawl. set-time-zone-offset.do would store the browser's clock offset for date display; update-global-search.do refreshes the client's search index. Neither reaches ACCURATE. customer/pos-trans-failed.do: the sales-receipt screen asking after failed point-of-sale syncs; this database has no POS.

app._comment: The app is ready when its sidebar's module buttons exist (they are bound from one list, so one means all).
app._screens: Every opened entry is a window (.module-container) under the app's tab bar. A transaction entry opens as its empty new form; the Daftar button (module-list-button) toggles the list of records; the window's tab closes with its aol-main-tab-close.

menu._comment: ACCURATE's sidebar is a column of icon buttons; each opens a submenu whose entries are links to hash routes (#accurate__<area>__<screen>). The module's key is read from its icon's class; its label from the submenu heading, else from labels.
